code='''def transform(grid):
    a=[r[:] for r in grid]
    R,C=len(a),len(a[0])
    seen=set()
    from collections import deque
    comps=[]
    for i in range(R):
      for j in range(C):
       col=a[i][j]
       if col in (6,9) or (i,j) in seen: continue
       q=[(i,j)];seen.add((i,j)); pts=[]
       for x,y in q:
        pts.append((x,y))
        for u,v in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
         if 0<=u<R and 0<=v<C and (u,v) not in seen and a[u][v]==col:
          seen.add((u,v));q.append((u,v))
       xs=[x for x,y in pts];ys=[y for x,y in pts]
       t,b,l,r=min(xs),max(xs),min(ys),max(ys)
       if len(pts)==(b-t+1)*2+(r-l+1)*2-4 and b-t>=2 and r-l>=2 and all(a[t][y]==a[b][y]==col for y in range(l,r+1)) and all(a[x][l]==a[x][r]==col for x in range(t,b+1)):
        comps.append((col,t,b,l,r))
    for col,t,b,l,r in comps:
      fill=7
      if (b-t-1)*(r-l-1)>=20: fill=2
      for x in range(t+1,b):
       for y in range(l+1,r): a[x][y]=fill
    return a
'''
